Babhruvāhanavijaya

See NCC. IV. p. 175a.

Babhrusmṛti
Kavīndrācārya 648. Q. in Parāśaramādhavīya, Oxf. 266b.

Bābhaṭa
grammarian. mentioned by Jagadīśa in Śabdaśaktiprakāśikā. See JASB. XI (1915). 282.

Bābhravya(pāñcāla)
a. ancient authority on Kāmaśāstra; mentioned by Vātsyāyana in Kāmasūtra I. i.; condensed in sūtra form Kāmaśāstra of Śvetaketu; in 150 chs. in 7 adhikaraṇas on each of which such a. Sādhāraṇa section seven separate writers like Cārāyaṇa wrote their works (See GD. 1425). [Page261-a.
His work was the basis for Vātsyāyana especially the Sāmprayogika sn. See Kasi edn. of Kāmasūtra p.. 68. 79. 94 etc. Q. by Jayamaṅgala. He may be identical with Bābhravya Pāñcāla mentioned by Uvaṭa an. Ṛkprātiśākhya (11. 65) a. a. of Kramapāṭha of Ṛv. See Y. Mimamsak, Sam3skrita Vyākaraṇ Śāstra kā Itihās I. p. 70; his Kramalakṣaṇa is mentioned by Narasim3ha in Jaṭālakṣaṇa, TCD. 34K; identified a. Gālava in Mahābhārata (See NCC. VI. p.. 18b-19a).
Q. by Jyotirīśvara in Pañcasāyaka, IO. 1237 an. by Kāñcīnātha in Ratirahasyadīpikā, IO. 1240.

Bābhravyaśākhā
Sv. work cited by Madhva. See BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. I. p. 356.
